styles.name: Satellite Briefing
styles.note: BLOCKED: Two blockers. (1) The story is fiction in an invented place: AKI's run, the puddle and the station clock happen on a street that does not exist. Putting them on a real photograph of a real town would present a simulation as an observed fact, which the brief forbids ("Non… presentare le simulazioni come riprese autentiche"); drawing an invented street as if it were imagery would break the style's first rule. (2) The imagery is out of reach at the scale the story needs: the whole event covers about 40 m of pavement, so the dive has to end on sub-metre aerial imagery. The hosts the library's demo and docs use answer `403 (agent proxy: no rule allows this host)`: `planetarycomputer.microsoft.com`, `gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov`, `tiles.maps.eox.at`, `api.pdok.nl`, `basemap.nationalmap.gov`. Only 10 m Sentinel-2 tiles on `sentinel-cogs.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com` answer, and at 10 m the street is four pixels wide.

styles.name: Engineering Briefing Board
styles.note: BLOCKED: The board is built from photographs of real objects (a wristwatch, a station clock, a rain puddle, a train ticket, a coat), and the library ships none (the demo fetches them in its tools). Drawing the objects in code or rendering 3D models and calling them photographs would break the style's rule; it is not replaced by a generic version.

styles.name: LiDAR Survey
styles.note: BLOCKED: The data host is reachable (`s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public` answers 200), so this is not a network block. The blocker is the story: a lidar survey of Station Road cannot exist because the street is invented, and AKI cannot appear in a real scan, since making a runner out of points would be "moving points into a shape", fabricated data presented as a measurement. Surveying some real street and claiming it is hers would present a simulation as an observation, which the brief forbids.

styles.name: 3D Map Explainer
styles.note: BLOCKED: Elevation is reachable (`copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com` and `elevation-tiles-prod.s3.amazonaws.com` answer 200), and so is 10 m Sentinel-2 (`sentinel-cogs.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com`). The blockers are (1) the place: our story happens on an invented street, and a 3D relief map has to show a real place, so placing the run there would present the fiction as geography; and (2) the scale: the event covers about 40 m, below what 30 m elevation and 10 m imagery can show, and the licence-clean mosaics the style uses for the wide shot answer `403`: `tiles.maps.eox.at` (Sentinel-2 cloudless), `gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov`.
